alert.note: Fictional exercise message for the AapdaSaathi demo ward. Not issued by any authority.

info.headline: DEMO EXERCISE: Flash flood likely along the stream in Demo Ward DW-01 within 20 minutes.
info.description: DEMO EXERCISE ONLY. Heavy rainfall upstream may cause a sudden rise in water level along the stream bed in the fictional demo ward.
info.instruction: DEMO EXERCISE: Move away from the stream bed to Demo Relief Post A. Help elderly and disabled neighbours. Do not cross flowing water.

info.headline: डेमो अभ्यास: डेमो वार्ड DW-01 में 20 मिनट में अचानक बाढ़ की संभावना।
info.instruction: डेमो अभ्यास: नदी तल से दूर डेमो राहत केंद्र A पर जाएँ। बुज़ुर्ग और दिव्यांग पड़ोसियों की मदद करें।
